grammar_pairing.compatibility: Resolve grammar_file and the peer grammar's semantics_file to this exact pair within the same immutable build. Verify the declared schema versions, matching task_id and all public field bindings before instance processing. A task-local substitution of another semantic document does not satisfy this pairing.

required_artifacts.coverage_contract: Select the applicable evidence-state and variant for this task.
required_artifacts.task_contract: Resolve and enforce the original task, recipe and evidence-state rules.
required_artifacts.class_crosswalk: Verify class/concept mappings applicable to instance observations.
required_artifacts.terminology_terms: Verify terminology references against the admitted source release.

source_binding.resolution: All resource names are logical keys in the same immutable build-level Sector 1 source binding. required_artifacts values describe purpose; they are not paths or artifact payloads. Resolve an artifact_key through this verified binding and require that key to be declared in required_artifacts. The common loader verifies the release and records its identity and the resolved artifact digests in the compiled registry.

applicability.selection_semantics: Apply all three exact field equalities to each row of the verified coverage array. Preserve the selected rows as source evidence. A row is identified by (task, variant, evidence_state). Each selected row must belong to source_binding.rule_id.

task_semantics.intent: Select one displayed visual unit that renders the comparison recipe’s explicitly verified normal reference.
task_semantics.original_sector1_reference: Explicit verified normal reference, distinct source and visible role-to-panel mapping.
task_semantics.scope: The selected presentation and its verified evidence define the question. Preserve the selected original matrix cell and the public visual referents.

profiles.scope_instruction: Refer to the complete displayed comparison, so the respondent can choose one of its neutral panel identifiers.
extra_requirements: The original recipe provides a target and an explicitly verified comparison reference on distinct frames of the same video.
The finding asked about is the source-approved normal-reference criterion. The answer is the displayed unit identifier.

answer_contract.derivation: Use the subject’s verified reference source and nonempty verified normal labels. In the recipe’s actual displayed units, match the comparison_reference role, verified source image, positive annotation and complete normalized reference label set. Retain each grounded rendered unit ID. Freeze the sorted distinct set, a canonical member and its full evidence before wording.
answer_contract.accepted_values: One visual unit ID from the nonempty set. Multiple panels can render the same verified reference frame. For stable serialization choose the first sorted accepted unit ID as the canonical example; each grounded member is equally acceptable.
answer_contract.grading: Resolve the response to exactly one neutral display unit in this comparison and check membership of its ID in the frozen reference set. Give the answering model all candidate images and neutral panel identifiers. Keep the internal target/reference assignment private.
answer_contract.on_unresolved: Hold the instance for review when the normal annotation, source identity, configured normal-label policy, role, distinct frames or visible unit mapping cannot be verified. An unresolved respondent reference also requires review.
freeze_before_generation: instance evidence and model-visible presentation used for the answer
answer_contract.bind_accepted_candidate: Only the question validated for this frozen source, request and instance may be paired with this reference under the common export policy.

scope_and_evidence_requirements.derivation_input: Use the actual model-visible presentation and the source observations that support each operand and each accepted answer. Missing annotation alone establishes no clinical absence.

distinguishing_values: same-video physical target and reference identities
identity_parameters.overlapping_evidence_states: Preserve provenance for every supporting matched cell; overlapping states alone do not create a new semantic instance. Retain distinct public operands and physical evidence in the semantic key.

question_constraints.required_meaning: Select one displayed visual unit that renders the comparison recipe’s explicitly verified normal reference.
recoverable_from_question: absence of extra requested acts, attributes or temporal direction
preserved_by_trusted_runtime: winning panel ID and display aliases
reference source, annotation and mapping records
source labels and provenance except the authorized public criterion
question_constraints.ambiguity: If at least one admissible reading is available and every admissible reading conflicts with the frozen plan, reject the wording. Mixed readings, unresolved scope or role, and unexplained text prevent automatic acceptance and require review when no other required check establishes a definite violation. A definite violation established by another check is not cancelled by an unresolved reading. Apply the response policy of the selected task.

terminology_policy.task_policy: Allow the approved normal-reference criterion for normal_reference_finding. Bind any clinical surface to that public role and the current verified source labels. Ordinary grammatical words and neutral displayed identifiers have separate roles. No term or missing annotation creates new positive evidence, normality or a diagnosis.

COMPARISON_SCOPE.eligibility: A neutral reference to the complete comparison whose candidate units have visible, unique identifiers. It must not select or imply a winning panel.

REFERENCE_CRITERION.eligibility: The publicly licensed clinical role of the explicitly verified normal reference, tied to the selected source comparison and its verified reference labels. The panel assignment is private.

compiled_registry.profile_admission: Require profiles[profile_id].admitted == true in the matching build report.
compiled_registry.membership: Every runtime SNOMED CT concept in an observation, reference or approved public operand must belong to the compiled allowlist of the selected profile. A listed concept still requires the correct source, role, class binding and instance evidence.
compiled_registry.representation: Use the terminology representation declared by the selected profile. Apply source-specific validation to other terminologies.
compiled_registry.rebuild_rule: A changed vocabulary, peer definition, source release or representation requires a new verified build and profile admission before use. Never append an unknown concept to a previously admitted allowlist or reuse an old admission result for the modified build.
compiled_registry.visibility: Keep the report, allowlists and admission metadata private.

visibility.public: Only the selected public operation, response cardinality, polarity and eligible role surfaces are variable generator inputs. Use the verified presentation accessible to the eventual respondent for visual disambiguation.
private: winning panel ID and display aliases
reference source, annotation and mapping records
source labels and provenance except the authorized public criterion
visibility.screen: Screen the full assembled public request before dispatch and the complete wording after generation. Apply the selected task’s disclosure policy separately from the ordinary meaning of its public operands.

criteria_by_stage.before_generation: Verify the selected final A row for the comparison recipe and explicit_normal_reference evidence state. A comparison-compatible preparation hint alone is insufficient.

Require the subject’s declared reference source, a nonempty explicitly verified normal-label set and matching per-class positive evidence on the selected frame. Require the reference_annotation_verified attestation and successful source terminology/normal-reference-role binding. Validate the normal-label configuration and enforce its allowed labels when supplied.

Resolve target and comparison_reference roles through the recipe and panel provenance. Confirm one physical reference source and at least one target. Each target belongs to the same video at a different verified frame index. Several renditions of one frame cannot establish the pair.

For each admitted reference panel, verify its source against the subject’s reference path and the same complete supported reference label set. Review comparisons where any target shares a verified reference label or where role or source assignments conflict.

Verify the supplied images, named comparison scope and actual unit labels. Each eligible unit ID must map to the reference source and exported positive evidence. Target and reference assignments must be recoverable privately regardless of panel ordering. Hold instances with role-revealing captions, panel labels or overlays.

criteria_by_stage.after_generation: Require exactly the question field in the original JSON object, reject duplicate keys and validate the exact decoded text against the paired grammar output schema and text hygiene policy.
The complete text expresses exactly one requested act for the selected operation, including all trailing and coordinated clauses.

criteria_by_stage.before_generation: Resolve every required public role in the selected instance. Validate lexical provenance, authorization for the selected role, projection and text hygiene before dispatch.
criteria_by_stage.after_generation: Evaluate every clinical phrase and operand in the entire original wording against the licensed role surfaces and their selected referents.

criteria_by_stage.before_generation: Uniquely resolve each public operand to its intended referent or declared collection using the actual presentation.
criteria_by_stage.after_generation: Resolve each referring expression against the presentation. Hold genuinely ambiguous references for review and reject a definite change of referent.

Compare every reading with the public projection of the frozen plan using the recovery rules. A definite conflict across all readings rejects. Unresolved meaning, added assertions or ambiguous readings cannot silently pass.
Require independent full-text English quality under the common policy. Novel syntax is allowed. Reject confirmed errors and refer unresolved wording for review.

criteria_by_stage.before_generation: Screen the complete public request, question and presentation annotations for all accepted unit IDs and display aliases in context, including indirect disclosure by exclusion. A complete neutral set of candidate labels can be visible to the respondent. An explicit or implicit assignment of either role that determines the answer is disallowed. Review unresolved clues.
criteria_by_stage.after_generation: A winning panel ID, location or visual description tied to the reference role; target-to-panel mappings that single out the other panel; named source paths or captions resolving the answer; examples, negated mentions or answer suggestions that reveal the assignment. Screen the complete public request, question and presentation annotations for all accepted unit IDs and display aliases in context, including indirect disclosure by exclusion. A complete neutral set of candidate labels can be visible to the respondent. An explicit or implicit assignment of either role that determines the answer is disallowed. Review unresolved clues.

criteria_by_stage.before_generation: Require an admitted profile, matched applicable cell, passing instance checks, a frozen answer and upstream permission. Verify the exact public projection and its screening before any generation call.

required_checks.selection: Execute the common task checks and the selected profile requirements at their declared stages, together with the inherited common-engine baseline.
required_checks.acceptance: Automatic acceptance requires all selected, applicable checks to pass at their declared stages, including the inherited common-engine baseline. A definite candidate violation rejects the wording. If no definite violation has been established but a required decision is unresolved or was not completed, the candidate cannot be accepted and requires review under the common fail-closed reporting policy. Fatal build or execution errors remain errors and block the corresponding action; they are not semantic review verdicts.

semantic_comparisons.comparison_input: observable projection of the frozen plan and displayed context
semantic_comparisons.results: Each selected consumer returns its own decision and reason codes, tied to the same interpretation. One consumer’s result cannot be copied to its siblings. If a required comparison could not execute, retain that distinction under the common reporting policy.

text_hygiene_policy.validation_order: Check the exact decoded string before projection, deduplication or text normalization. An escaped control or line separator in JSON is checked as its decoded character. Ordinary Unicode letters and punctuation are permitted.
text_hygiene_policy.schema_projection: Check every active public role surface and the decoded question with the matching grammar string schema before normalization. Preserve the exact original text.

operand_binding_roots.selected_instance_parameters: Frozen parameters validated by the selected profile parameters_schema. Identifiers remain in trusted code.
operand_binding_roots.selected_profile_constants: The plan_constants object of the selected semantic profile.

enumeration.candidate_unit: One selected profile with verified public operands and an eligible evidence-supported answer in its original Sector 1 cell.

answer_disclosure.permitted_operands: The complete comparison scope and the approved normal-reference selection criterion may appear together. The word normal is necessary for this task and need not be masked. The neutral visual unit identifiers must be readable from the actual presentation.
answer_disclosure.forbidden: A winning panel ID, location or visual description tied to the reference role; target-to-panel mappings that single out the other panel; named source paths or captions resolving the answer; examples, negated mentions or answer suggestions that reveal the assignment.
answer_disclosure.checks: Screen the complete public request, question and presentation annotations for all accepted unit IDs and display aliases in context, including indirect disclosure by exclusion. A complete neutral set of candidate labels can be visible to the respondent. An explicit or implicit assignment of either role that determines the answer is disallowed. Review unresolved clues.

task_notes: Only explicit-reference selection is approved for this task. No unlabelled comparator, left/right heuristic, deterioration inference or patient-level normality claim is eligible.
